dedupe_keys.name: greek wetlands website and inventory database wwf greece

description: The website on the wetlands of Greece, run by WWF Greece, was designed to give access to reliable scientific information on the more than 1,000 small and large wetlands spread across Greece. It holds inventory data, maps the boundaries of the wetlands, and gathers information and photographs, with pages by region (Attica, Eastern Macedonia and Thrace, Western Greece, Western Macedonia, Epirus, Thessaly, Central Macedonia, the Peloponnese and Central Greece), a map, statistics, and climate change pages on carbon storage and flood mitigation. The site aims to support public services, research institutes and environmental groups, to assess changes in wetland ecosystems, and to speed up the legal protection of wetlands outside protected areas under biodiversity law 3937/2011. It explains wetland types such as deltas and notes that many wetlands are Ramsar sites or part of the Natura 2000 network. Access is free online; no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the site is in Greek, and the page read does not say whether the boundary data can be downloaded. Coverage is Greece. It supports blue-green infrastructure and nature-based flood mitigation planning, and screening of projects near wetlands; related records are the EELIS Estonian nature information system and the Dominican protected areas KMZ layers.
